historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 5-year average revenue growth (-7, -2, 0, +1, +1.5). Historical equity CAGR (-12%) is a record of impairments and RMB2.6bn of dividends paid out of IPO cash, not a forward growth proxy; revenue 5yr CAGR (+8.1%) is inflated by the FY2021 acquisition year and has been negative since.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-12%) diverges by more than 30pp from revenue 5yr CAGR (+8%): equity shrank through RMB2.4bn of cumulative net impairments FY2022-FY2025 and RMB2.6bn of dividends; neither is a growth signal. EPS 3yr CAGR undefined (FY2022 loss base).
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income - lease cash, RMB m): FY2020 ~945; FY2021 ~-750; FY2022 ~-683; FY2023 ~662; FY2024 ~47; FY2025 ~-103. The series is dominated by related-party collection timing (FY2023's inflow was collateral/settlement-driven), so no FCF CAGR is meaningful; the forward build starts from a near-zero owner-FCF base and earns its value from collection normalisation, not from growth.

scenario_narratives.base: The annuity survives the parent but never fully escapes it. Revenue drifts down ~7% in FY2026 (Zhangtai deconsolidation plus project exits) and stabilises near RMB6.2-6.4bn with no Sunac pipeline; the non-residential and commercial lines offset residential attrition. The admin-cost programme and the 'Clearance Action' hold pre-impairment EBITDA around 15%. The decisive variable is collection: the non-collection charge (impairment) falls from ~9% of revenue to ~4% by 2031 as the 93%-provided related-party book stops growing and the worst third-party projects are exited, but stays well above the 1-2% of SOE-backed peers because 73% of managed GFA is Sunac-built. Cash tax normalises as provisions stop inflating taxable income. Owner FCF goes from ~zero to ~RMB425m by 2030 and ~RMB500m at maturity (7% margin). Terminal value capped at 12x. The RMB3.3bn of cash is taken at a 35% haircut in every scenario.
scenario_narratives.bull: Collections genuinely cure. Sunac China's two restructurings (Dec 2025) and the chairman's 'largely resolved' statement prove right: related-party impairments go to zero, the exited-project programme lifts third-party collection, and the 15th Five-Year Plan's property-service agenda allows modest fee indexation. Revenue returns to +2-3% growth from FY2028 on non-residential wins (AI/semiconductor facilities, data centres, asset-light malls); pre-impairment EBITDA reaches 16.5% and the non-collection charge 2.5% (the CG Services post-peak level), so cash EBITDA hits 14%. Cash tax normalises to 26%. Terminal cap 14x, 2.5% growth. The cash haircut still applies: even in the bull the board has not shown it will return the cash.
scenario_narratives.bear: The subsidiary keeps functioning as the parent's bank. Sunac China (RMB116bn overdue mid-2026, still loss-making) keeps leaning on the services arm: related-party receivables keep accruing and get provided, third-party owners of defect-ridden Sunac stock keep withholding fees, and government-guided fee cuts push the gross margin down. Revenue shrinks ~9% then ~6%, ~4%, ~3% and flattens near RMB5.1bn by 2035; pre-impairment EBITDA slips to 13.5% and the non-collection charge only improves to 7%, so cash EBITDA is 3.5-6.5% and owner FCF is roughly zero for two years before reaching ~RMB170m. Cash tax stays punitive. Terminal growth zero, cap 10x. Note the bear does not touch the 35% cash haircut; a deeper raid on the cash (a parent-related acquisition, a loan, a perpetual non-distribution) is the tail beyond the bear.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the recurring property-management annuity on what it collects, not what it accrues, by treating receivables impairment as an operating cost and normalising it to a mid-cycle level that reflects a permanently Sunac-weighted portfolio; value the cash pile at a haircut that reflects its captivity inside a defaulted developer's group rather than at par; charge no risk premium in the discount rate so each risk is priced once. The market cap sits below the cash: the stock is an option on the board returning that cash, and the haircut is the model's price for that uncertainty.
key_risks_to_valuation: Captive-cash haircut (35%) is the single largest judgment: cash at par adds HK$0.45/share to every scenario; a perpetual non-distribution or a parent-related asset purchase would justify a deeper haircut than the bear scenario carries
Non-collection charge path: every 1pp of permanent non-collection is ~RMB65m/yr of owner FCF (~HK$0.25/share at the terminal multiple)
Cash tax rate on post-impairment EBIT is modelled far above statutory because provisions are non-deductible; the RMB1.14bn deferred tax asset is uncredited upside if write-offs are eventually allowed
Revenue base erosion: 73% of managed GFA is Sunac-built with no new pipeline; project exits are deliberate but shrink the base, and government-guided fee cuts are a sector-wide headwind
Governance: CEO, CFO and several directors are current or former Sunac Group executives; connected-transaction caps govern a large share of the business
Balance-sheet seasonality: the 30 Jun 2026 cash (3,286m) is the seasonal low; Dec-2025 was 4,040m and H2 collection typically brings 700-800m back

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,027,973,000 shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (interim note 23), less 24,400,000 repurchased-but-uncancelled at 30 Jun 2026 and 4,104,000 repurchased 2 Jul-25 Aug 2026 (interim p.1208-1230) = 2,999.5m. No options, RSUs or other potential ordinary shares (interim note 13: diluted EPS = basic). The Sunac Shine share-award trust holds 396.7m issued shares (13.1%) which ARE in the count (they sit in the EPS denominator); scheme terminated 13 Aug 2026 so no further grants. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.cash_composition: 30 Jun 2026 available funds per MD&A s.11: cash and cash equivalents 2,826.9 + restricted cash 23.1 + bank deposits >3 months 28.0 + wealth-management products at FVPL (current, redeemable, 0.32-4.03% yield) 408.0 = 3,285.9. Borrowings nil (gearing nil). Lease liabilities (90.7m) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Seasonal low point: Dec-2025 available funds were 4,040.0 and H1 is always the operating-outflow half for PRC property managers (fees collected at year end).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR cash-flow add-back / note 26 share award scheme, RMB8.302m (0.12% of revenue); equity-award taxes nil (shares granted from an existing trust, no net-share settlement). Scheme terminated 13 Aug 2026; SBC path runs to zero by year 3.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow RMB9.015m (prepayment for repurchases). H1 2026 pace much higher: RMB44.63m for 52.2m shares (HK$50.9m), plus 4.1m shares (HK$3.3m) Jul-Aug 2026. Buybacks are value-neutral here (count held flat, SBC expensed); recorded for the reader.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1726 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T13:26Z). Parity: USDHKD 7.8475 / USDCNY 6.6755 = 1.1755 and 1/HKDCNY 0.8519 = 1.1738, both within 0.3%. Statements and all flows are RMB (interim p.1464 'RMB000'); the HKEX quote is HKD. Unsuffixed per-share values are HKD; *_cny twins are the model currency. No dual listing to parity-check the equity price.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z (HKEX regular close, Friday 16 Oct 2026; not an after-hours print)
inputs.share_count_date: 2026-06-30 issued count, adjusted for repurchases to 2026-08-25 (interim report date)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y China government bond ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5%, beta ~1.15 for HK-listed PRC property managers -> cost of equity ~9.3%; no borrowings so WACC = CoE; rounded to 9.5%. NO parent-risk premium stacked on the rate: parent/collection risk is charged once, in the flows (the impairment/non-collection charge inside the EBITDA margin) and in the bridge (captive-cash haircut), and the same 9.5% is used in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost: full lease cash (principal 19.593 + interest 5.573 = RMB25.2m FY2025, 0.37% of revenue; H1 2026 12.0m, 0.37%) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (RMB90.7m at 30 Jun 2026) excluded from net debt; da_pct is ex right-of-use depreciation (~RMB20m/yr of the FY2025 RMB132.9m D&A).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; NCI charged once in the equity bridge. Book NCI is only RMB90.6m but NCI took RMB35.6m of FY2025 profit (15%) and RMB16.6m in H1 2026, so the stock is deducted at ~8x FY2025 NCI profit share (RMB280m), not at book.
inputs.ebitda_definition: ebitda_margin_path is CASH-COLLECTED EBITDA: gross profit - admin - S&M + other income (ex interest) + D&A, MINUS the net impairment loss on financial assets treated as an operating cost. Impairment here is not a one-off: it is the share of accrued revenue the company does not collect (FY2024 impairments 1,388m / receivables build 690m; FY2025 563m / 652m; H1 2026 308m). Pre-impairment EBITDA margin: FY2024 15.8%, FY2025 14.0%, H1 2026 16.2% (H2 is seasonally weaker). Non-collection charge: FY2024 19.9% (1,059m related-party), FY2025 8.3%, H1 2026 9.5%. Base case normalises the charge 9.0% -> 4.0% by 2031 (peers CR Mixc/Poly run 1-2%; distressed-developer-linked CG Services ~3-4% post-peak); 73% of managed GFA is Sunac-built so a full peer-like cure is not assumed.
inputs.cash_tax_note: PRC statutory 25%; cash tax is paid on PRE-impairment profit because receivable provisions are not deductible until written off (DTA now RMB1,138m). Cash tax paid: FY2024 244.6m, FY2025 151.3m, H1 2026 129.4m. Expressed against post-impairment EBIT the cash rate is therefore very high while the non-collection charge is large, and falls as it normalises: base 60% -> 28% (28% not 25% for the withholding tax on PRC dividends). The RMB1.14bn DTA is NOT credited in the bridge (realisation requires actual write-offs of parent receivables); it is unmodelled upside.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, non-US, lease/NCI/dual-currency adaptations applied; SKILL.md routing row 2). Fresh build, no prior DCF or memory entry. Property management is a recurring-fee annuity, but this one is a subsidiary of a defaulted developer (Sunac China, ~RMB116bn overdue borrowings mid-2026), so three adjustments beyond the engine default: (1) MID-CYCLE NORMALISATION of the non-collection charge inside the EBITDA margin rather than carrying FY2025's trough or FY2021's peak; (2) a CAPTIVE-CASH HAIRCUT in the equity bridge (35% of the RMB3,286m available funds = RMB1,150m): the market cap (~RMB1.82bn) is below the cash, the dividend was cut 93% to RMB0.01 while the cash sits at ~1.5% yields, and ~RMB2.8bn of shareholder cash has already migrated to the parent via related-party receivables now 93% provided (interim note 19, gross 3,194m / allowance 2,776m) plus RMB626m of car-park-agency deposits; 35% is the PV loss of cash held captive ~6 years at deposit yields against a 9.5% CoE ((1.015/1.095)^6 = 0.64). Cash-at-par is reported as a memo: add RMB1,150m / 2,999.5m x 1.1726 = HK$0.45/share to every per-share value. (3) NO WACC premium -- see wacc_rationale. Working capital: wc_capture 10% on the revenue change (contract liabilities/prepaid fees 1,492m shrink as the base shrinks; the structural receivables build is in the EBITDA line, not here). D&A (1.6% ex-ROU) exceeds capex (1.2%) because of acquired-intangible amortisation (intangibles 763m); treated as a genuine tax shield. SBC is near zero and the award scheme is terminated, so house and street bases nearly coincide: read band_position as degenerate (effectively null), not as a finding. FX: all modelling in CNY, converted at 1.1726 to HKD for the quote-currency per-share values. Anchors: price HKEX close 16 Oct 2026; balance sheet 30 Jun 2026 (seasonal low for cash); H1 2026 interim is the latest filing.

bear.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-impairment EBITDA 14.0 -> 13.5% (fee caps and cost inflation outrun the cost programme) minus non-collection charge 10.5, 10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.5, 7.0 ... (parent leakage via receivables continues, third-party collections on Sunac-built stock stay poor).

base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-impairment EBITDA 14.5 -> 15.3% (admin ratio keeps falling, loss-making project exits, offset by fee caps) minus non-collection charge 9.0, 7.5, 6.0, 5.0, 4.5, 4.0 ... 4.0%.
base.growth_note: FY2026: H1 -9.2% reported (-2.3% ex Zhangtai disposal, deconsolidated Aug 2025), H2 comparison partly normalises -> ~-7%. FY2027 -2% as the 'Clearance Action' keeps exiting loss-making projects; flat FY2028; +1-1.5% thereafter from non-residential wins and fee indexation, no parent pipeline assumed.

bull.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-impairment EBITDA 15.0 -> 16.5% minus non-collection charge 8.0, 6.0, 4.5, 3.5, 3.0, 2.5 ... (approaching the CG Services post-peak level).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 35% (house default 15%): the thesis rests on an unproven pivot (collection normalisation) inside a subsidiary of a defaulted developer with shared executives; solvency is not the issue (nil debt, RMB3.3bn cash) but cash captivity and continued related-party leakage are structural, and all three covering analysts are at Sell. Bull 15% (default 35%): the bull needs three independent things -- a cure of related-party receivables, a third-party collection recovery on Sunac-built stock, and a return to growth without a parent pipeline -- and the board has given no sign it will return the cash. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
